title: kith-store advance_state: pub method with phantom-advance footgun undocumented externally
description: ChatStore::advance_state() is documented as only for test use but is pub because kithd tests need it from another crate. The docstring says 'never in production code paths' but the only enforcement is the prose comment. A future contributor adding a handler in kith-chat who needs to advance state for a test could copy this pattern and call it in production. Risk: phantom state advance (counter moves but no row has changed_at_counter stamped). Should use cfg(test) + a separate test-only module, or a pub(crate) alias via a feature flag.
